meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

copy.tagline_en: Query gene, sequence, and structure data from 20+ bio databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need quick lookups of gene, sequence, and protein structure data in bio research.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可通过命令行或 Python 调用 gget 查询 20+ 生物信息数据库,涵盖基因信息、序列、BLAST/BLAT、蛋白结构、表达与疾病数据等,结果以 JSON、CSV 或 DataFrame 返回。
howto.when: 当你需要快速、交互式的单次查询(如基因信息、序列获取、BLAST/BLAT 比对等)时触发;原文建议批量处理或复杂 BLAST 改用 biopython。

howto.what_en: Once installed, gget lets Claude query 20+ bioinformatics databases from the CLI or Python: gene info, sequences, BLAST/BLAT, protein structures, expression and disease data, returned as JSON, CSV or DataFrames.
howto.when_en: Use it for quick, interactive single lookups such as gene info, sequence retrieval or BLAST/BLAT searches; the skill suggests biopython for batch processing.
